title: Let "try again on" accept failed jobs and carry their reason
summary: `athena ask "try again on <job>"` currently accepts only rejected jobs. I read the request as making it accept failed jobs too (such as one refused at admission) and carrying the recorded outcome reason into the reader's brief as the earlier attempt's finding.

defaults_applied.how: Add unit and lifecycle tests for retrying a failed job; cargo test and clippy must pass.
Limit the change to the retry path (earlier_attempt, carry, brief wording) plus docs.
Update CHANGELOG and README for an outside reader.
Exercise the behavior through the lifecycle test.

assumptions: 'try again on <job>' (athena ask) is the retry path; `athena go` on closed jobs stays terminal, per the user's reply.
The failure reason is already stored in the outcome record (Happened::with_reason in run.rs), so the fix is reading it back, not changing what is recorded.
A failed-at-admission job has a request record but may have no verification record; the outcome reason is the only failure text available.
Failed jobs that did have verification still carry its findings in addition to the outcome reason.

acceptance_criteria.text: In crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs, earlier_attempt accepts a job closed as failed as well as rejected; other states (open, accepted, stale, etc.) still bail with a message naming the state and that only rejected or failed jobs can be tried again.

carry includes the job's recorded outcome reason (e.g. 'admission refused the change: ...') as a finding, redacted, when the job has no verification record. A failed job with no verification record no longer triggers the 'no verification record' bail.

The 'Earlier attempt' section in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs says the job failed or was rejected according to its actual state, rather than always 'was rejected'; the new request still takes precedence.

A new test in crates/athena-cli/tests/lifecycle.rs makes a job fail at admission, then asks 'try again on <job>' and shows the reader brief contains the admission refusal reason and the original request. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test lifecycle`.
Unit tests in reading.rs and briefs.rs cover a failed job being accepted and its reason carried, and a non-retryable state still being refused. Run `cargo test`.
`cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets` run clean, and the existing retry tests still pass.
CHANGELOG.md and README.md (the 'try again on' paragraph) say that failed jobs can be tried again and that their recorded reason is carried into the reader's brief.

out_of_scope: Changing what the outcome record stores
Retrying jobs closed as stale or other states
